reading.title: The Old Sewing Machine
reading.text: My grandmother has an old sewing machine in her room. It is more than forty years old, but it still works well. She uses the machine to make dresses and curtains for the whole family. Last week it suddenly stopped, and she was worried. My uncle, who knows a lot about machines, looked at it and found a broken needle. He fixed it in five minutes. Grandma was so happy that she made him a cup of tea. She says modern machines are fast, but her old machine is her best friend.

reading.title: The Science Club
reading.text: Our school has a science club, and it meets every Wednesday after lessons. Last month the school bought new equipment for the lab, including six microscopes and some safety glasses. The room is now equipped with modern computers, too. Mrs Davis always asks us to check the equipment before we use it, and to put everything back carefully. Last week there was a small problem with an electrical piece of equipment, and we had to wait. A technician fixed it quickly. We love our club, and we feel lucky to learn with such good equipment.

reading.title: The Broken Lift
reading.text: Yesterday morning the lift in our building stopped working. A small note on the door said that there was a technical fault. Mrs Brown, who lives on the eighth floor, had to walk up the stairs with her shopping. She was not angry and did not find fault with anyone, because she knew it was nobody's fault. In the afternoon an engineer arrived and found an electrical fault in the control panel. He repaired it in an hour. By the evening, the lift worked again, and everybody in the building was happy.

reading.title: Fixing the Bike
reading.text: Last Sunday my bicycle's front tyre was flat, and the chain was loose. At first I thought it was beyond repair, because the bike is very old. My neighbour, Mr Gafur, has a small repair shop on our street. He looked at the bike and said that it was only in need of a quick repair. He changed the tyre and tightened the chain in twenty minutes. The repair costs were very small, only a few dollars. Now my bike runs like new, and I ride it to school every day. Next time I will learn to do simple repairs myself.
